name: River Development Agent Controlled Operation Execution Receipt Foundation
architecture: GENERATION III CONTROLLED OPERATION EXECUTION RECEIPT FOUNDATION
invariants: DEV-276 consumes only the exact DEV-275 controlled operation execution boundary result contract.
DEV-276 denies receipt creation when the DEV-275 predecessor is malformed, untrusted, unready, not executed, blocked, inconsistent, or missing required execution evidence.
DEV-276 records only deterministic receipt data.
DEV-276 does not execute or re-execute an operation.
DEV-276 does not retry execution.
DEV-276 does not create new execution authorization.
DEV-276 preserves the exact approved execution scope.
DEV-276 preserves predecessor provenance and execution evidence.
DEV-276 does not expand execution scope.
DEV-276 does not invoke an executor.
DEV-276 does not persist lifecycle state.
DEV-276 does not modify repository content.
DEV-276 does not delete repository content.
DEV-276 does not stage repository changes.
DEV-276 does not commit.
DEV-276 does not push.
DEV-276 does not deploy.
DEV-276 does not access secrets.
DEV-276 does not perform arbitrary shell execution.
DEV-276 does not perform network execution.
DEV-276 does not perform external side effects.
Rejected predecessor payloads release no trusted predecessor payload.
A future explicit execution lifecycle boundary is required before downstream lifecycle progression.
